description: Compare explicit food and prayer evidence across Japan with source dates and honest unknowns.

tools.name: prayer_get
tools.description: Inspect prayer-space facilities and explicit access evidence. Required: id. Returns the Place.

tools.name: prayer_search
tools.description: Search mosques and prayer spaces by destination. Optional: query, prefecture, category (default: prayer) (plus 2 more). Returns array of Place.

params.name: query
params.description: Keyword from the source search field

params.name: prefecture
params.description: Japanese prefecture, such as Tokyo or Kyoto

params.name: place-type
params.description: Source prayer type spaces or mosques

tools.name: restaurants_get
tools.description: Inspect restaurant food conditions and source verification. Required: id. Returns the Place.

tools.name: restaurants_search
tools.description: Search restaurants by destination and source filters. Optional: query, prefecture, genre (plus 2 more). Returns array of Place.

params.name: query
params.description: Keyword from the source search field

params.name: prefecture
params.description: Japanese prefecture, such as Tokyo or Kyoto

params.name: genre
params.description: Source cuisine label, such as Ramen

params.name: feature
params.description: Source food condition key, such as certified
